grid-template-columns.$description: Three columns that every item shares: the key, the value, and the optional actions. The key column fits its content with a limit of 15rem or 30% of the list, whichever is smaller. The actions column fits its content with a limit of a quarter of the list, and collapses when no item has actions. Min-content sizing can exceed these limits.
